en: A black‑and‑white historic view of a harbor with sailing ships and a steamship moored along a quay. On the left side there are multi‑story brick warehouses and other port buildings lining a canal or basin. In the distance are low hills and a rocky outcrop. On the right foreground is a wide street or promenade with a few blurred pedestrians, a horse‑drawn carriage, and gas‑style street lamps. The photograph has the look of an early maritime cityscape reproduced as a vintage postcard. No printed caption or handwriting is visible.
